step_by_step_reasoning:
The architecture diagram illustrates Ztore's e-commerce recommendation system on AWS, split into two pipelines: User-Item and Cart-Item recommendations.

1. User-Item Pipeline:
   - CloudWatch Schedule triggers an EC2 instance daily to retrain the user recommendation model.
   - The EC2 instance writes pre-computed user recommendation results to DynamoDB.
   - Incoming web traffic arrives at the ALB, which routes requests to an ECS service running on Fargate.
   - The ECS (User-Item) service fetches recommendation results directly from DynamoDB.

2. Cart-Item Pipeline:
   - An EC2 instance periodically retrains the cart-to-item model and writes model artifacts to S3.
   - The EC2 instance signals ECS (Cart-Item) to perform a rolling re-deployment.
   - Upon startup, the new ECS (Cart-Item) container tasks load the updated ML model directly from S3.
   - Traffic for cart recommendations is routed from the ALB to the ECS (Cart-Item) service.
